# Repository agent guidance

Before creating, updating, or merging a pull request, read the root [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), including its **Agent-requested Codex review** policy. Classify the complete final diff; skip ordinary changes by default and prioritize concrete high risks within the shared owner-wide limit of one review request per four eligible PRs. Uncertainty alone does not trigger review. Do not automate PR review through Actions; preserve the documented existing release-tag exception in AGENTS.md.
